## What changed?

Describe the recipe, component, division dish-off, game-day menu, or tooling change.
For menus, name the teams/theme and link the recipes used. For components, list the
recipes using it and the homemade/buy-it alternatives.

## Content type

- [ ] Recipe
- [ ] Make It or Buy It component
- [ ] Division dish-off
- [ ] Game-day menu (Grudge Match Grub, Shared Prep, Across the League, Premium/Fast/Budget Day)
- [ ] Tooling or documentation

## Sources and rights (recipe/content changes)

- Original recipe/source URL:
- Evidence of the dish's connection to the city:
- Have you cooked this version? What did you change?
- Photo creator, original URL, license/permission, and required attribution:
- Any other third-party material and permission to redistribute it:

## Checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and kept this PR focused.
- [ ] Ingredients, quantities, yield, timing, and numbered steps agree.
- [ ] Menu recipe IDs/component references resolve; division menus use their own division (if applicable).
- [ ] Authentic preparation is preserved; shortcuts are explicitly optional.
- [ ] I have permission to contribute the text/images; attribution alone is not permission.
- [ ] `make check` passes, or I described the issue below.
- [ ] I added an Unreleased changelog entry for a visible change.
- [ ] I did not edit generated files, bump the version, or create release tags.

For changes affecting published output, include PDF/website build results or state
that maintainer assistance is needed. For code-only changes, mark source/rights items N/A.
